Apruebo y confirmo los conceptos 19011505, 40173584, 40173587, 40173588. Teniendo en cuenta las siguientes observaciones del evaluador clínico/técnico:

Para responder a la pregunta clínica, el agente debe construir una consulta SQL que utilice la tabla `concept` para identificar los fármacos (concept_class_id en 'clinical drug' o 'branded drug') y los nombres de marca (concept_class_id = 'brand name'). Es fundamental unir estas tablas a través de la tabla `concept_relationship` utilizando los siguientes tipos de relación: 'Constitutes' (para descomponer Clinical Drugs), 'Has tradename' (para vincular fármacos con sus nombres comerciales) y 'RxNorm has ing' (para asociar nombres comerciales con ingredientes de marca). El filtro principal debe ser `concept.concept_id` igual a 19011505 para el nombre de marca 'Fosamax', además de asegurar que las relaciones sean válidas mediante las columnas `valid_start_date` y `valid_end_date` en la tabla `concept_relationship`.

Genera directamente la consulta SQL SELECT para BigQuery consultando las tablas del modelo OMOP (concept, concept_relationship) utilizando los concept IDs aprobados.

args.sql_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    c2.concept_id,
    c2.concept_name,
    c2.concept_class_id,
    c2.domain_id,
    c2.vocabulary_id
FROM
    `concept` AS c1
JOIN
    `concept_relationship` AS cr
    ON c1.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
JOIN
    `concept` AS c2
    ON cr.concept_id_2 = c2.concept_id
WHERE
    c1.concept_id IN (19011505, 40173584, 40173587, 40173588)
    AND cr.relationship_id IN ('Constitutes', 'Has tradename', 'RxNorm has ing')
    AND c2.concept_class_id IN ('Clinical Drug', 'Branded Drug', 'Brand Name')
    AND cr.valid_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE()
    AND cr.valid_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE()
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT
    c.concept_id,
    c.concept_name,
    c.concept_class_id,
    c.domain_id,
    c.vocabulary_id
FROM
    `concept` AS c
WHERE
    c.concept_id IN (19011505, 40173584, 40173587, 40173588)
    AND c.concept_class_id IN ('Clinical Drug', 'Branded Drug', 'Brand Name')

SELECT DISTINCT
    brand_name.concept_name AS brand_name,
    product_drug.concept_id AS product_concept_id,
    product_drug.concept_name AS product_concept_name,
    product_drug.concept_class_id AS product_concept_class,
    product_drug.domain_id,
    product_drug.vocabulary_id
FROM
    `concept` AS brand_name
JOIN
    `concept_relationship` AS cr_tradename
    ON brand_name.concept_id = cr_tradename.concept_id_2
JOIN
    `concept` AS drug_with_tradename
    ON cr_tradename.concept_id_1 = drug_with_tradename.concept_id
JOIN
    `concept_relationship` AS cr_product
    ON drug_with_tradename.concept_id = cr_product.concept_id_1
JOIN
    `concept` AS product_drug
    ON cr_product.concept_id_2 = product_drug.concept_id
WHERE
    brand_name.concept_id = 19011505
    AND brand_name.concept_class_id = 'Brand Name'
    AND cr_tradename.relationship_id = 'Has tradename'
    AND cr_tradename.valid_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE()
    AND cr_tradename.valid_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE()
    AND cr_product.relationship_id IN ('RxNorm has ing', 'Constitutes')
    AND product_drug.concept_class_id IN ('Clinical Drug', 'Branded Drug', 'Quantified Clinical Drug', 'Clinical Drug Form', 'Branded Drug Form')
    AND cr_product.valid_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE()
    AND cr_product.valid_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE()
